byCarZh: 國道 1 號（三義交流道下）：接台 13 線往卓蘭方向 -> 轉苗 52 線（經鯉魚潭水庫風景區）接台 3 線 -> 抵達卓蘭景山里，循山語 Villa 指標即可抵達。
國道 4 號（豐原/東勢端下）：沿台 3 線往石岡、東勢、卓蘭方向前行 -> 進入苗栗卓蘭景山里 -> 依指標上行即可抵達。
導航定位建議：Google 地圖搜尋「苗栗縣卓蘭鎮景山里8鄰127-10號」或「山語 Villa」，沿途均為平整雙向柏油道路，行車順暢安全。
byCarEn: Via National Freeway 1 (Sanyi Interchange): Take Provincial Hwy 13 toward Zhuolan -> Connect to Miaoli Route 52 (via Liyutan Reservoir) to Hwy 3 -> Follow Shan Yu Villa signs.
Via National Freeway 4 (Fengyuan/Dongshi End): Follow Provincial Hwy 3 toward Shigang, Dongshi, and Zhuolan -> Enter Jingshan Village, Zhuolan Township.
GPS Navigation: Search for 'Shan Yu Villa' or 'No. 127-10, Neighborhood 8, Jingshan Vil., Zhuolan Township, Miaoli'. Roads are paved and safe for all standard passenger vehicles.
transportation.byPublicZh: 搭乘高鐵至「苗栗站」或「台中站」，轉乘計程車或自駕租車前往苗栗卓蘭山語 Villa；亦可提前向管家諮詢推薦在地專車接駁服務。
transportation.byPublicEn: Take Taiwan High Speed Rail to Miaoli or Taichung Station, then transfer via taxi or rental car to Zhuolan, Miaoli. Concierge driver coordination is available upon prior request.

dining.nameZh: 苗栗大湖福菜園客家菜餐廳
dining.descZh: 道地客家風味餐廳。一桌型的菜要預先預定才有，特別推薦 6,800 元桌菜，份量澎湃、CP 值極高（如果要訂兩桌以上需預付 2,000 元訂金）；亦有 1,500 ~ 3,000 元合菜可供選擇。
dining.descEn: Authentic Hakka banquet restaurant. Pre-booking required for table set menus. The NT$ 6,800 set menu offers incredible value (NT$ 2,000 deposit required for 2+ tables); 1,500-3,000 options also available.
dining.noticeZh: 一桌型菜需事先預訂；訂兩桌以上需先預付 2,000 元訂金
dining.noticeEn: Pre-booking required; NT$ 2,000 deposit for 2+ tables

dining.nameZh: 苗栗縣大湖鄉 雲也居休閒農場
dining.nameEn: Dahu Yun Ye Ju Leisure Farm
dining.descZh: 坐落於薑麻園山脈之上的景觀農場餐廳，主打精緻美味的特色定食與客家家常料理，飽覽晨昏壯闊雲霧。座位熱門，強烈建議事先電話預約。
dining.descEn: Scenic farm restaurant on the Jiangmayuan ridge, famous for flavorful farm-to-table set meals and sweeping cloud views. Advance phone reservation is highly recommended.
dining.noticeZh: 主打精緻定食，最好事先電話預約
dining.noticeEn: Specializes in set meals; advance phone booking advised

dining.nameZh: 苗栗縣卓蘭鎮 鵝肉擔
dining.tagZh: 鮮嫩甜美・超人氣名店・附停車場
dining.descZh: 卓蘭極具盛名的在地美食名店！鵝肉鮮嫩細緻多汁，深受老饕喜愛。每次營業生意都極好，備有專屬停車場，建議務必事先電話預訂以省去久候。
dining.descEn: Top-rated local favorite in Zhuolan. Renowned for succulent and savory sliced goose meat. Very busy during peak hours; parking lot available, pre-booking strongly advised.
dining.noticeZh: 肉質鮮嫩多汁生意超好，備有停車場，最好事先預訂
dining.noticeEn: Very popular, parking available, pre-booking recommended

dining.nameZh: 苗栗縣卓蘭鎮 口福鵝肉店
dining.tagZh: 老饕口袋名單・傳統美味
dining.descZh: 在地深耕的經典老字號鵝肉小吃，肉質香甜紮實、風味純粹道地，搭配客家沾醬堪稱一絕。惟店家無專屬停車場，建議提早抵達並於周邊街道停車。
dining.descEn: Beloved traditional eatery famous for tender goose platters with classic Hakka dipping sauces. Please note there is no private parking lot; roadside parking nearby.
dining.noticeZh: 傳統口碑老店，無專屬停車場需路邊停車
dining.noticeEn: Classic local delicacy; no private parking lot

dining.nameZh: 苗栗縣大湖鄉 七里香甕仔雞（大湖店）
dining.tagZh: 現烤甕仔雞・香酥溪蝦・附停車場
dining.tagEn: Roasted Urn Chicken · River Shrimp · Parking
dining.descZh: 如果聚餐特別想吃雞，這間甕仔雞非常推薦！現烤出爐外皮金黃酥脆、肉感十足鮮嫩多汁；私房配菜強力推薦必點他們的酥炸溪蝦。備有專屬停車場，便利好停。
dining.descEn: The top choice for succulent oven-roasted urn chicken with crispy golden skin. Don't miss their crispy deep-fried river shrimp. Spacious parking lot on site.
dining.noticeZh: 甕仔雞肉感十足，推薦必點溪蝦，附專屬停車場
dining.noticeEn: Crispy juicy roasted chicken, recommended river shrimp, free parking

attractions.tagZh: 壯麗雲海・拍照合照勝地・有停車場
attractions.tagEn: Sea of Clouds · Scenic Photos · Parking
attractions.descZh: 坐落於關刀山系稜線，風景秀麗絕美，視野開闊無際。晨昏時分雲霧繚繞，非常適合全家大小及好友拍照留念。園區設施完備，備有專屬停車場。
attractions.descEn: Nestled along the mountain ridge with expansive scenic vistas and frequent sea-of-clouds spectacles. An ideal spot for family and group photography. Parking lot available.
attractions.noticeZh: 風景絕美很適合拍合照，備有停車場
attractions.noticeEn: Superb mountain views for photos; parking available

attractions.tagZh: 百年鐵道・Rail Bike・需線上預約
attractions.tagEn: Century Station · Rail Bike · Pre-book Online
attractions.descZh: 西部鐵路海拔最高點的百年日式木造古蹟車站，周邊充滿懷舊客家老街風情。現場有熱門的舊山線鐵道自行車（Rail Bike），名額有限，務必事先於網路線上預約訂票。
attractions.descEn: Historic century-old wooden railway station at the highest elevation of Taiwan's western railway. Famous for the Old Mountain Line Rail Bike; advance online booking required.
attractions.noticeZh: 舊山線鐵道車需事先在官方網站預約（現已開放線上預訂）
attractions.noticeEn: Rail bike tickets must be reserved online in advance

attractions.tagZh: 強力推薦・鐵道小火車 A/B/C 線・需線上預約
attractions.tagEn: Must Visit · Rail Bike Routes A/B/C
attractions.descZh: 【強力推薦】壯麗的紅磚糯米拱橋遺跡，見證關刀山大地震的歷史滄桑。設有舊山線鐵道小火車，規劃 A、B、C 三條路線，各路線沿途風景與風格皆別具特色，值得一搭，請務必事先於網路預約訂票。
attractions.descEn: 【Highly Recommended】Majestic century-old red brick bridge ruins. Features Old Mountain Line Rail Bike with Routes A, B, and C each offering distinctive historical sceneries. Online pre-booking required.
attractions.noticeZh: 有小火車 A, B, C 三條路線可搭，風格各異，請事先於網路預訂
attractions.noticeEn: 3 rail bike routes (A, B, C) available; online reservation required

attractions.nameZh: 泰安竹林秘境（烏嘎彥竹林）
attractions.nameEn: Taian Wugayan Bamboo Forest Secret Path
attractions.tagZh: 京都嵐山田園風・翠綠竹海・打卡勝地
attractions.descZh: 隱身於泰安山林的翠綠竹林步道，翠竹高聳參天遮蔽日光，宛若置身日本京都嵐山竹林之道。林間微風徐徐，光影交錯，是享受靜謐氛圍與拍攝美照的絕佳去處。
attractions.descEn: A tranquil towering bamboo tunnel hidden in the mountains of Taian, reminiscent of Kyoto's famous bamboo groves. Cool, breezy and scenic for photography.
attractions.noticeZh: 享受竹林靜謐之美，極度適合漫步與拍照留念
attractions.noticeEn: Tranquil bamboo canopy, great for strolling and photography

attractions.tagZh: 美人湯泉質・露天SPA・可自備外食
attractions.tagEn: Natural Hot Spring · Outside Food Allowed
attractions.descZh: 坐落於自然山林邊的露天溫泉園區，泉質清澈滑順、舒筋活血。園區親切友善，特別允許遊客自行攜帶外食與零食點心進場野餐，非常適合親友一同放鬆享受。
attractions.descEn: Popular natural outdoor hot spring pools surrounded by mountain greenery. Notably permits visitors to bring their own outside food and snacks for leisurely picnicking.
attractions.noticeZh: 可自備零食與餐點，園區內全面允許攜帶外食
attractions.noticeEn: Visitors may bring their own snacks and outside food

attractions.tagZh: 百年名湯・原始清澈・蓊鬱山林環繞
attractions.descZh: 坐落於蓊鬱山脈與清澈溪谷之間的百年溫泉勝地。擁有台灣最原始清澈、水質純淨溫潤的無色無味弱鹼性碳酸氫鈉泉，浸泡其中可洗滌身心疲憊，盡享山林寧靜。
attractions.descEn: Historic hot spring district nestled in verdant mountain ravines. Features Taiwan's most pristine, crystal-clear weak alkaline bicarbonate spring water for deep relaxation.
attractions.noticeZh: 坐落於蓊鬱山脈中的溫泉區，泉質最為原始清澈純淨
attractions.noticeEn: Pristine clear hot springs nestled in dense mountain forests

attractions.nameZh: 雪霸國家公園 雪見遊憩區
attractions.nameEn: Shei-Pa National Park Xuejian Recreation Area
attractions.tagZh: 遠眺聖稜線・建議自備乾糧・會車請慢行
attractions.tagEn: Holy Ridge Vista · Bring Food · Caution on Forest Road
attractions.descZh: 雪霸國家公園的重要遊憩據點，視野極為壯麗，晴朗時可遠眺壯闊聖稜線群峰。園區內餐飲選擇不多，強烈建議遊客自行攜帶輕食乾糧上山；聯外司馬限林道路幅狹窄且會車不易，開車前往請務必放慢車速、小心駕駛。
attractions.descEn: A premier alpine recreation area in Shei-Pa National Park offering breathtaking panoramas of the Holy Ridge skyline. Park dining options are minimal—bringing light snacks/meals is strongly advised. The access forest road is narrow; drive cautiously.
attractions.noticeZh: 聖稜線視野絕佳；園內餐飲少建議自備乾糧；林道狹窄會車請慢行
attractions.noticeEn: Superb views; bring dry food; forest road is narrow, drive carefully
